English Language Proficiency Admission—
Table 2: Designated Countries and Other Recognised English Language
Proficiency Tests or Qualifications
Notes for Part A and Part B
1. Results are generally valid for 5 years from the date of the qualification being granted to the
commencement date at UQ. Citizens of designated countries listed in Part A of Table 2 are
exempted from the 5-year validity period.
2. Countries marked with a '^' are exempted from the 5-year validity period.
3. It is assumed that the applicant will have completed the entire school qualification, where applicable,
and the required results were achieved at year 12 (or equivalent).
4. Conditions for higher-than-minimum ELP programs apply only if English Language Proficiency
Admission—Table 1 explicitly permits such application. Specific application of clause 8(c) of English
Language Proficiency Admission Procedure provided for a program in English Language Proficiency
Admission—Table 1 takes precedence over generic conditions for higher-than-minimum ELP
programs provided in Other Recognised English Language Proficiency Tests or Qualifications Table
above.
Last approved: 20 May 2025 4
